item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers limited preview support for AI model management, letting users provision fully managed models directly in the database. The preview covers embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates
